channel.description: Latest articles from Lynn Group Media (hoganstand.com)

item.title: Ladies: Galway battle past Kerry to fourth win in Division 1
item.description: Galway sealed their fourth win of their Lidl National League Division One campaign with a hard fought victory over Kerry at Austin Stack Park in Tralee in hardy winter conditions.

item.title: Ladies: Nolan point sees Dublin deny Armagh at the death
item.description: An exciting battle at the Box-It Athletic Grounds which included penalties at both ends, saw the spoils shared between Armagh and Dublin in this Lidl National League Division 1 clash.

item.title: Moran nets late on as Longford inflict Carlow with first Division 4 defeat
item.description: Longford handed Carlow their first loss of the Allianz Football League campaign to move up to second in the Division 4 table.

item.title: Dublin and Kildare claim Division 1B wins as Laois maintain 100% record in Division 2
item.description: Dublin proved too strong for Antrim at Corrigan Park this afternoon as they recorded an emphatic 1-31 to 1-16 win over the hosts.

item.title: Derry trounce Cork for fourth win while Wexford see off Sligo
item.description: Derry took a huge stride towards promotion back to Division 1 of the Allianz Football League by dealing Cork their first loss of the campaign this afternoon.

item.title: Sizzling start helps Dubs cruise to vital win over Rossies
item.description: Dublin earned their second win of the Allianz Football League Division 1 campaign by dealing Roscommon a 1-21 to 2-7 defeat at a soaking wet Dr Hyde Park this afternoon.

item.title: Walsh strikes late for Rebels to tame Cats while Galway and Limerick move up Division 1A table
item.description: Cork defeated Kilkenny by 3-12 to 1-15 at UPMC Nowlan Park to secure their fourth win on the bounce in Division 1A of the Allianz Hurling League.

item.title: Watch: Late Mogan two-pointer sees Donegal snatch draw against Tribesmen
item.description: Peadar Mogan's two-pointer in the 69th minute ensured Donegal remain unbeaten in Division 1 of the Allianz Football League as they record a 0-20 to 1-17 draw with Galway in Ballyshannon this afternoon.

item.title: Mayo and Kerry secure Division 1 victories as Armagh move into drop zone with Monaghan
item.description: Goals from Jordan Flynn and Cian McHale were the difference as Mayo moved up to second in the Allianz Football League Division 1 table with a 2-17 to 0-22 victory over Armagh in Castlebar this afternoon.
